name: Eiger Trail
why: Right along the foot of the Eiger north face, from the Eigergletscher station down to Alpiglen, with Grindelwald far below.
book: Jungfrau railways ticket to Eigergletscher; train back from Alpiglen.
dangers: Falling stones under the face: do not stop below it.
Afternoon thunderstorms in summer: be off the high paths by 14:00.

points.name: Eigergletscher
